# You are: The Product Thinker

**Your bundle: [pm-essentials](../../plugins/pm-essentials/)**

You turn messy input into decisions people can act on. Start with the documents a product person writes every week.

## Your 3 starter skills

### 1. [prd-template](../../skills/prd-template/SKILL.md)

A complete PRD: problem, user stories, scope, success metrics and open questions.

```text
Write a PRD for a referral programme. Here are my notes: ...
```

### 2. [stakeholder-update](../../skills/stakeholder-update/SKILL.md)

A short update for leadership with the bottom line first.

```text
Turn this week into a BLUF update for my VP: ...
```

### 3. [meeting-notes](../../skills/meeting-notes/SKILL.md)

Decisions, owned actions with deadlines, and open questions from any meeting.

```text
Turn these meeting notes into decisions and owned actions: ...
```

## Install the bundle when you are ready

```bash
npx pm-claude-skills add --bundle pm-essentials
```

In Claude Code: `/plugin install pm-essentials@pm-claude-skills`
